title: Tower cut opener (prototype)
alignment: Fixed base line, the height growing by class: every tower's base (or where its axis leaves the frame) sits on y=990 on the centre line x=960 and its top straight above it, at a height set by its class (distribution 680 px, 35 kV and 35-110 kV 720, 330 kV 840, 750 kV 900, the crossing towers 960). Chosen over one fixed top height because the poles are small in the dashcam frames: stretching them to a crossing tower's height would upscale them 3-4x. The heights were raised (from 560/610/690/820/900) so each frame fills more of the canvas; poles that would then need more than about 2.2x upscaling were left out. One similarity transform per frame (shift, uniform scale, rotation).
rules: pixels only resampled (area when shrinking, bicubic otherwise) and cropped; never generated, filled, inpainted or sharpened
black where the moved frame does not cover the canvas
hard cuts; one fade from black at the start
no text, marks or labels drawn; no sound
logos, captions and channel overlays cropped off (crop) or left outside the canvas
